public_surface.imports: Python standard library only; no controller, transport producer, simulator, predecessor candidate, subject, provider, network, or collaboration runtime is imported or called

report.valid_meaning: The supplied terminal evidence is internally exact and independently reopenable. Valid controller-invalid, stopped, subject-fail, synthetic, or canary evidence does not receive qualification credit.

custody.bundle_rows: Exact sorted successor-relative path, SHA-256, and byte-count rows recomputed from live files
custody.actual: GIT_HEAD_PINNED; the recorded commit must exist and every exact live bundle file must equal its blob at that commit

frozen_route_mapping.rule: For every frozen routes.json row, pass thinking unchanged as collaboration.spawn_agent reasoning_effort; no substitution or fabricated identity is allowed.

row_evidence.packet: Exact frozen render UTF-8 including its sole terminal LF
row_evidence.message: Exact 174-byte transport instruction plus packet bytes without the packet LF
row_evidence.spawn_request: Sorted-key minified UTF-8 request object with no LF; exact hash and byte count are bound
row_evidence.spawn_receipt: Success is the exact six-field event with tool_result equal to only the expected canonical task path

failure_events.spawn_attempt: The sole spawn_receipt.json event; no raw result or completion; controller invalid and global halt
failure_events.terminal_drain: raw_result.json terminal_delivery after an exact success receipt; no completion; controller invalid and global halt
failure_events.terminal_split: controller_invalid.json and matrix cause preserve the exact typed failure; the complete-row-only controller path reopen records the admitted prefix as one row file inventory mismatch; this verifier independently validates the exact four-file or five-file prefix and accounting

activity.count_fields: First seven fields are nonnegative non-boolean integers
activity.nonterminal_message_rule: One-based contiguous sequence, MESSAGE type, exact UTF-8 hash and byte count

causal_and_terminal_rules.causal_inputs: Exact sorted kind/id/path/storage-hash/storage-bytes references; no missing, extra, future, failed, or mutated dependency
causal_and_terminal_rules.subject_fail: First valid FAIL permanently stops that slot; other slots continue
causal_and_terminal_rules.controller_invalid: Typed transport failure or any malformed identity, event, hash, custody, causal, inventory, schedule, terminal, or accounting evidence globally halts
causal_and_terminal_rules.clean_matrix: Exactly 291 PASS completions and 54 eligible route-local stage artifacts
causal_and_terminal_rules.accounting: Attempts, captured raw results, valid completions, unknown dispatches, failures, stops, aborts, artifacts, and matrix binding are recomputed

checks: exact expectation v3 and direct-child nonlink run root
semantic manifest, pipeline, routes, schedule, semantic receipt, architecture transport, addendum, and capability receipt
exact 18-row live bundle and recorded Git custody
run v3 schedule identities, route roster, cardinality, and unique predeclared values
complete six-file row inventory or exact typed failure prefix
packet, spawn message, attempt, request, receipt, terminal delivery, activity, raw result, score, and completion hash chain
causal gates, stage eligibility, fail and halt rules, path terminals, matrix terminal, and accounting
global nonce, invocation, and canonical-path freshness across sibling run roots
nonclaims: No evidence is written, repaired, deleted, renamed, resumed, or relaunched.
No provider, subject, model, network, or collaboration call is made.
Historical evidence using the retired result envelope cannot qualify under this contract.
A valid synthetic run remains zero-credit development evidence.
Verifier validity is not a candidate, audit, freeze, canary qualification, readiness, release, launch, or safety claim.
Requested route fields and a returned canonical task path do not independently attest effective provider routing or unexposed internal activity.
residuals: A final filesystem snapshot cannot independently reconstruct historical create-only and fsync system calls.
The trusted root actually issuing the retained request, effective provider routing, and activity not exposed to the root remain trusted obligations.
